name: Elegant Casting

components.pose: She stands barefoot with one leg stepping forward, both hands opening like blossoms as vines and flowers spiral up her arms and unfurl between her palms, head tilted, a warm, radiant gaze to the camera. A breeze streams her skirt, petals and hair. No weapon or staff - casting with her bare hands only.
components.effects: Vines, blossoms and glowing {{MAGIC}} seeds spiral up her arms and unfurl between her palms, petals streaming on the wind.

notes: Elegant casting: unique gown that fits her magic, hands-only complex casting stance with wind.
